QuestInfo.name: The Language of Forget-Me-Nots
QuestInfo.0:
You returned to the spring with Paeon, but the Forest Master doesn't wake up.
Rather, memories of a #rterrible#k past life encroached on your mind. What you did back then has come back to haunt you...
QuestInfo.1:
Your heart is still pounding.
This is more than a mistake. You committed a terrible crime...
QuestInfo.2:
In your past life, you poached the Forest Master's antlers, and fought with your Spirit Guides when they tried to stop you.

What kind of person were you?
Even if it was a past life, you still regret it deeply. 
Regardless, there's nothing you can do about it now. 

All you can do is show the Spirit Guides, who still stand with you despite having seen what you saw, that you're a better person now.
Maybe even #bPaeon#k will come to believe it.
